caption_en: Ride the roads, cross rivers and watch weather, stamina and supplies before choosing your next destination.
caption_zh: 沿着道路策马，穿越河流；把天气、体力和补给都算进下一段旅程。

caption_en: Study the wanted posters, compare the rewards and choose whose trail you will follow.
caption_zh: 读通缉令，比较赏金与目标信息，决定这趟出门追谁。

caption_en: Enter a larger frontier with treasure hunters, settlements and a live leaderboard. Getting rich also means getting home.
caption_zh: 走进有聚落、有盗宝人动态排行的大地图；找到财富之后，还得活着把它带回家。

caption_en: Carry a map tied to one treasure. Found gold, gems and loot only become yours after returning to your starting town.
caption_zh: 藏宝图绑定独一份宝藏；挖出的金币、宝石和物资需要回出生城镇结算，才真正落袋。

caption_en: Try the Endless Night expedition and its changing fugitive activity. Darkness changes the mood of the same frontier.
caption_zh: 进入永夜远征，观察动态生死榜与亡命徒活动；熟悉的荒野在黑夜里换了一副面孔。

title_zh: 🐎 挑一匹陪你闯荒野的坐骑
caption_en: Compare animals and their prices in the mount market before committing your hard-earned cash.
caption_zh: 在牲口市场看坐骑、比价格；一笔买卖，会改变你以后怎么赶路。

caption_en: Visit the stable to manage your animals and inspect the companion that carries you into the wilderness.
caption_zh: 在马厩管理已有牲口，查看陪你出门的伙伴；坐骑也是边境生活的一部分。

title_en: 🏇 Place your faith in a horse
caption_en: Compare runners in the race hall, then decide whether the odds deserve your wager.
caption_zh: 先看参赛马，再决定把筹码押在哪里；赔率与直觉，这次你信谁？

caption_en: A captured winning race: the podium, wager and net payout appear together. A good pick can turn the day around.
caption_zh: 这场实机赛马押中了冠军：领奖台、下注和净收益一起揭晓，选对一次也能翻身。

caption_en: The casino offers several ways to tempt your luck. Choose a table while keeping the debt ledger in mind.
caption_zh: 赌场里有多种玩法可选；想试试运气，也别忘了月底那本债务账。

title_zh: 🎡 轮盘转起来，结果会怎样
caption_en: Take a seat at roulette and make your bet. Fortune moves quickly; your next repayment is still waiting.
caption_zh: 坐上轮盘桌，选定你的下注；运气会转，下一次还款日也会来。

caption_en: The revolver table brings opponents, items and a life-or-death wager into one tense scene.
caption_zh: 左轮赌桌上有对手、有道具，还有性命作筹码；每一步都比普通赌局更紧张。

caption_en: Visit the financial market to inspect prices and trading options. Frontier life has more than one route to money.
caption_zh: 去金融市场查看行情与交易选择；接赏金、去淘金之外，也能在城里寻找赚钱机会。

caption_en: Customize the character and mount appearance before stepping back into the tavern.
caption_zh: 在角色与坐骑装饰界面挑选造型，再带着自己的风格回到酒馆。

title_zh: 🏰 把酒馆布置成你的据点
caption_en: Use the in-game decoration editor to select and arrange objects in the 3D tavern.
caption_zh: 在游戏内的布置工具中选择、摆放物件；3D 酒馆可以成为你亲手安排的据点。

caption_en: Return to the warm lamps, fireplace and notices. Plan the next job while the calendar and debt keep moving.
caption_zh: 回到灯火、壁炉和告示旁，筹划下一单生意；日子与债务不会等人。
